title: Attractive but uncomfortable
text: Attractive but uncomfortable. These stools match my kitchen beautifully. They are very attractive and they were easy to put together. The swivel mechanism works extremely well. The downside is that they are VERY uncomfortable. I can't imagine anyone sitting in one for more than a few minutes. With regret I plan to explore returns with Amazon.

features: Overall counter stool size is 18"W x 17"D x 40"H. Seat Dimension is 17. 4"W x 16. 9"D.
Seat Height is 24. 7" From floor. Weight capacity 220 lbs. Assembly required.
Made from solid wood with Seat in clear wood Finish and white accent on Back and base.
description: Display your classic sense of style with the traditional 24" Windsor swivel bar stool. This chair features a swivel seat and contoured back for maximum comfort that fits great for a counter. The seat Dimensions are 17. 4"W x 16. 9"D and has a weight capacity of 220 lbs. Made from solid wood in a natural and white finish. Assembly required.

What fun is a barstool without the swivel action? Winsome Wood's Windsor stool combines a seat that spins a full 360 degrees (wheee!) with an inviting, country-inspired style to complement casual decors. Pair it with a kitchen island, hobby table, or home bar for a perfect combination of easy movement and comfy support. Crafted of solid beechwood, this piece offers a rounded fan back with graceful arrow-shape posts and a solid, roomy seat. Underneath, the flared legs ensure tip-free steadiness, while two sets of staggered rungs all the way around give a place to park one's feet. This stool is available in 24-inch and 30-inch heights, and a choice of natural, natural and white, or natural and green finishes. It comes fully assembled.
